text: At 2 minutes into stoppage time, Harbour City pushes their defensive line higher up the pitch near the centre circle on their half, pressing intensely to reclaim the ball closer to Seabrook Town's goal at the far end. Seabrook Town remains positioned with a wide formation across the midfield, retaining possession to counter the pressure.
